findings.description: IDispatcher interface defined with all required methods
findings.notes: All methods present: initialize, shutdown, lookup, lookup_async, batch_lookup, check, remove, populate, touch, promote_to_memory_tier, clear_memory_tier, flush_to_ssd, reserve_memory, copy_gpu_to_memory_async, copy_gpu_to_memory_completed, release_memory, pin, unpin

findings.description: DispatcherError covers all failure modes
findings.notes: NotInitialized, KeyNotFound, AlreadyExists, AllocationFailed, IoError, Timeout, InvalidParameter

findings.description: populate() evicts if needed, allocates memory-tier slot via insert(), DMA copies D2H, registers in dispatch-map, enqueues write-through
findings.notes: Decomposed into reserve_memory + copy_gpu_to_memory_async + copy_gpu_to_memory_completed internally

findings.description: Background writer uses peek() (no LRU refresh) and writes to SSD via extent manager
findings.notes: process_write_job calls mt.peek() then writes via segmented I/O, calls convert_to_storage

findings.description: Memory-tier entry remains accessible after write-through completion
findings.notes: convert_to_storage sets ssd_offset but does not remove from memory-tier

findings.description: lookup uses memcpy_h2d_async on warm stream for MemoryTier; pipelined zero-copy for BlockDevice promotion
findings.notes: lookup_async: MemoryTier path uses warm stream with raw pointer memcpy_h2d_async; BlockDevice calls promote_and_serve; falls back to sync dma_copy_to_device when no stream

findings.description: lookup returns KeyNotFound for missing keys
check() returns presence without DMA
findings.notes: Queries dispatch-map, returns bool

findings.description: remove() frees memory-tier slot, dispatch-map entry, and SSD extent
findings.notes: Order: mt.remove, dm.remove, extent_mgr.remove_extent

findings.description: Uses define_component! macro, exposes IDispatcher
findings.notes: provides: [IDispatcher]

findings.description: Receptacles for ILogger, IDispatchMap, IGpuServices, ISPDKEnv, IMemoryTier, IRemoteLookup; poller_base_cpu supported
findings.notes: All six receptacles declared. poller_base_cpu in DispatcherConfig with per-drive CPU assignment

findings.description: initialize() validates dispatch_map and memory_tier bound; rejects empty data_pci_addrs
findings.notes: InvalidParameter for empty data_pci_addrs, NotInitialized for unbound receptacles

findings.description: Thread safety via dispatch-map read/write reference protocol
findings.notes: All operations use dm.lookup (read ref), dm.release_read, dm.release_write

findings.description: shutdown() drains bg writer, checkpoints extent managers, two-phase block device shutdown
findings.notes: Evictor shutdown, writer drain, extent_mgr.checkpoint(), signal_stop then shutdown in reverse order

findings.description: N block devices with N extent managers, co-located metadata
findings.notes: DataDrive struct pairs one block_dev_iface with one extent_mgr

findings.description: FormatParams computed from disk size and passed to extent manager
findings.notes: data_disk_size, sector_size, slab_size, max_extent_size computed and passed to iem.format()

findings.description: Write-through failure silently dropped
findings.notes: process_write_job returns early on I/O error, releases read ref

findings.description: Spec says remove does NOT block on write-through; interface doc contradicts this. Runtime behavior matches spec (non-blocking)
findings.notes: Interface doc says 'blocks until writer completes' but implementation uses read ref (non-blocking against other read refs). Documentation-only drift.

findings.description: MDTS-aware segmented I/O with zero-copy pipelines
findings.notes: pipelined_ssd_to_gpu_zero_copy (depth=16), pipelined_multi_object_zero_copy (depth=128), tag-based routing, periodic sync every PIPELINE_RING_SIZE=8

findings.description: touch() updates dispatch-map timestamp and memory-tier LRU without DMA
findings.notes: Calls dm.touch(key) + mt.touch(key), returns KeyNotFound if absent

findings.description: Capacity-based eviction with shard-targeted LRU + sparse clean-eviction probe
findings.notes: evict_lru_for_key(target_key) primary; every 8th iteration probes oldest_keys(4) + is_evictable; max_attempts from config (default 2048)

findings.description: format_on_init flag supported; when false, recovers dispatch-map from extents
findings.notes: Iterates for_each_extent, calls recover_extent, logs count and elapsed time

findings.description: Promotion re-inserts into memory-tier and re-registers as MemoryTier with ssd_offset preserved
findings.notes: dm.remove + create_memory_tier_entry + convert_to_storage(key, offset)

findings.description: Background SSD evictor started if threshold > 0.0 and drives exist; joined in shutdown
Evictor computes SSD utilization via sum(used_bytes)/sum(capacity_bytes)
findings.notes: Interval from ssd_eviction_interval_secs config

findings.description: Evicts oldest BlockDevice entries until below low_watermark or batch exhausted
findings.notes: Uses dm.oldest_keys(batch_size), re-checks utilization after each removal

findings.description: Skips MemoryTier entries; dm.remove failure handled gracefully
findings.notes: get_evictable_offset returns None for MemoryTier; dm.remove failure → continue

findings.description: DispatcherConfig includes all SSD eviction fields with correct defaults
findings.notes: ssd_eviction_threshold=0.9, low_watermark=0.8, batch_size=64, interval_secs=5, max_eviction_attempts=2048

findings.description: register_host_memory called on memory-tier pool; ClientChannels cached per drive
findings.notes: Registration failure logged as warning (non-fatal)

findings.description: unregister_host_memory called in shutdown before memory-tier teardown
lookup_async returns GpuStream; null stream for SSD path; lookup delegates + synchronizes
findings.notes: lookup() calls lookup_async then stream_synchronize if non-null

findings.description: Pre-allocated warm CUDA stream as AtomicU64; single stream; destroyed in shutdown
findings.notes: Lock-free access via Ordering::Acquire load

findings.description: clear_memory_tier() evicts all entries via evict_lru loop; IMemoryTier::clear() exists
findings.notes: Converts to BlockDevice or removes if transition fails

findings.description: batch_lookup with parallel cold promotion via ColdReadPool
findings.notes: Classifies entries, warm stream async + deferred sync, groups cold by drive, pipelined_multi_object_zero_copy with depth=128, MAX_QUEUES_PER_DRIVE=2

findings.description: promote_to_memory_tier: best-effort, fire-and-forget with per-drive threads
findings.notes: BlockDevice: pipelined_ssd_to_dram_only; MemoryTier: dm.touch + mt.touch; errors logged not propagated

findings.description: pipelined_ssd_to_dram_only and pipelined_multi_ssd_to_dram_only functions exist
findings.notes: Same NVMe queue depth saturation, no CUDA stream management

findings.description: populate + lookup round-trip via memory-tier path
check returns accurate presence info
remove frees memory-tier slot and SSD extent
Concurrent safety via dispatch-map reference protocol
Descriptive error for unbound receptacles
shutdown drains ParallelBackgroundWriter
N drives with splitmix64 key-based selection
Capacity-based LRU eviction transitions to BlockDevice
touch updates dm + mt without DMA
Entries evicted from memory-tier can be promoted back via pipeline
Zero-copy sliding-window pipeline with FIFO NVMe completion assumption
SSD evictor respects threshold and low-watermark
batch_lookup parallel cold promotion via ColdReadPool

unspecced_code.notes: Bounded crossbeam channel for external eviction event consumers (gRPC TakeEvents). No FR covers this notification mechanism.
Records timing of cold SSD reads, hot GPU DMA, populate phases. Public trait not referenced by any spec requirement.
Pre-connected NVMe channels and CUDA streams. FR-039 describes per-batch scoped threads; ColdReadPool is an optimization replacing that.
Forwards KeyNotFound entries to IRemoteLookup receptacle. FR-011 declares the receptacle but no FR specifies this forwarding behavior.
